notes.title: BASED demo update
notes.notes:
"Based on what?"

Based on YOUR Next Fest feedback!

Demo has been updated according to some common feedbacks I got during steam next fest. Key changes include:

[list]
[*]Complete battle UI Redesign! Posts will now autoposition in two columns, one for you and one for the enemy. If there is little space and posts start overlapping, posts that don't have any timeout, ongoing or triggered effects will hide behind those that do so that card text that isn't relevant anymore doesn't take up space.
[*]Music variety - let's not kid ourselves, it's still royalty free stuff I got for free. But it's not one track over and over again, which may have been annoying.
[*]One new enemy has sneakily found her way into the game. Don't worry though she's totally not a fed.
[/list]
